content:
Priya: Heads-up team  CardioSense is greenlit for a short customer story + a 45-min webinar demo. Goal: product launch tie-in (June). Need bench numbers, customer quote, legal release, and lead routing rules by EOD next Wed.
Ari: I'll draft a 600-800 word case and two headline options (technical + executive). Will wait for Dan's numbers before any % claims.
Jules: I'll own outreach and the recording ops. Asking Nina for a product PM + an infra engineer to co-present. Also will request a short 1-2 sentence quote for the blog.
Dan: Bench plan: run Llama-2-7b-chat q4f16 on g5.2-equivalent, measure median + p95 + tokens/s across 10 concurrent sessions. Will post CSV and a short runbook. Question: disclose GPU type?
Mei: Legal prefers we note "tested on representative infra" rather than a specific cloud SKU in public assets. Also need signed release and an option to anonymize cohort sizes. No PHI in screenshots.
Alex: CSM here  I'll nudge CardioSense legal contact and make approvals priority. Also send them our quote template.
Nina: Thanks, we can co-present. Legal wants 48-72h to review release and will likely request one anonymization (user counts).
Jules: Draft outreach to Nina sent at 10:03. Included proposed dates: Jun 8 or Jun 10, ask for speaker names + short bios.
leadgen-bot: Suggest SFDC campaign: "cardiosense-launch-jun". Recommend registration fields: company, role, product-interest, deployment-type. Route "Private" -> Enterprise AE.
Rowan: For webinar ops I'll provision Zoom Webinar and request a rehearsal slot. Need final slides by Jun 1. Rehearsal Jun 7 11:00 PT?
Ari: Draft hero variant 1 (dev): "CardioSense runs real-time cardiac risk scoring at lower latency with Redwood Inference." Variant 2 (exec): "Faster, cheaper clinical AI at scale." Posting both to doc: https://docs/g/cardio-draft
Dan: Uploaded raw results: https://drive.example/cardio/bench-2026-05-21.csv and runbook: https://drive.example/cardio/runbook.md. Warmup=400 tokens, batch=8. Seeding: 3 runs.
Priya: Mei  can you confirm anonymization approach? Nina said they'll want counts as ranges (e.g., "<10k").
Mei: OK to replace exact counts with ranges. I'll draft release with checkboxes for anonymization options and send to Jules for customer.
Jules: Sent release + redaction form to Nina at 14:12. Nina replied: "we'll sign, prefer counts as ranges, ok with methodology link, please redact internal cohort id."
Ari: Pushed blog draft w/ placeholders to doc. Early lede: \"CardioSense cut inference latency and operational cost using Redwood Inference; heres how they validated it in production-like tests.\"
Dan: Small technical snippet to include in appendix: 
```
python benchmark.py --model l2-7b-q4f16 --warmup 400 --concurrency 10 --seed 42
```
Please don't publish the gist until redactions applied.
Mei: Sent legal redline and final release form to Jules. Will sign off after redaction and customer confirmation.
Rowan: Calendar hold created: "CardioSense: Case + Webinar (tentative)" Jun 8 10:00 PT  https://calendar/evt/ccs-9987
Alex: CardioSense signed and returned release at 16:03. Selected anonymize counts. They gave a short quote: "Redwood helped us move to real-time scoring with predictable costs." Need to confirm exact phrasing.
Jules: Confirmed quote with Nina; she approved the exact line and signed. Uploading signed PDF to Drive.
Priya: Action checklist: 
- Dan: redact CSV (remove cohort id) + upload final redacted CSV (due 05/24)
- Ari: finalize blog + slides (due 05/28)
- Jules: finalize registration copy + speaker bios (due 05/25)
- Mei: final legal signoff (due 05/26)
- Rowan: rehearsal slot + ops (rehearsal 06/07)
React with :white_check_mark: when you accept.
Dan: :white_check_mark:
Ari: :white_check_mark:
Jules: :white_check_mark:
Mei: :white_check_mark:
Rowan: :white_check_mark:
leadgen-bot: Routing rule set in SFDC: campaign cardiosense-launch-jun, tag=cardio-case, route Private/Dedicated -> Enterprise AE, add utm_campaign=cardio-launch.
Priya: Good progress. Once assets are signed and redacted, open registration and schedule promotional emails (T-14, T-7, T-1). Also add nurture track for registrants that choose "Private".
Jules: Registration page draft: https://marketing/campaigns/cardio-live-draft. Need hero copy pick by 05/25.
Ari: Picking dev hero for registration, exec hero for press release. Posting final copy now.
Priya: Final note: ensure we include a clear CTA to request a dedicated trial in registration form to route to AE. If anything blocks, flag here and I'll escalate to Growth. :rocket:
